definitions.explanation: A road or path that goes upward. The physical sense of a slope that ascends.
Figuratively, a phase of improvement, growth, or increasing success in one's career, health, or other endeavors.

examples.japanese: この{先|さき}は{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}だ。
{急|きゅう}な{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}を{自転車|じてんしゃ}で{登|のぼ}るのは{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: Cycling up a steep uphill slope is tough.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}までずっと{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}が{続|つづ}くので、{歩|ある}くと{汗|あせ}をかく。
examples.english: The uphill slope continues all the way to the station, so I break a sweat when I walk.

examples.japanese: {景気|けいき}は{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}だ。
examples.english: The economy is on the upswing.

examples.japanese: あの{選手|せんしゅ}はまだ{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}で、これからもっと{活躍|かつやく}するだろう。
examples.english: That athlete is still on the rise and will likely achieve even more.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}から{回復|かいふく}して、{体力|たいりょく}は{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}に{向|む}かっている。
examples.english: After recovering from illness, my stamina is on an upward trend.

notes:
USAGE:
In the literal sense, {上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか} refers to a physical uphill slope. In the figurative sense, it describes something improving or gaining momentum, the opposite of {下|くだ}り{坂|ざか}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急|きゅう}な{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか} (steep uphill)
- {上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか}が{続|つづ}く (the uphill continues)
- {景気|けいき}は{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか} (the economy is on the upswing)
- {人生|じんせい}の{上|のぼ}り{坂|ざか} (an upward phase of life)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{下|くだ}り{坂|ざか} is the antonym, meaning downhill slope or decline.
